- **No black specks** (rules out Anthracnose stalk rot), **no pink/salmon coloring** (rules out Fusarium), **no wet/mushy appearance** (rules out Bacterial stalk rot)

- All leaf disease classes are irrelevant — test image shows stalk interior.

The tan/brown completely shredded dry pith with fibrous vascular bundles remaining is the hallmark of **Charcoal stalk rot** (*Macrophomina phaseolina*), which desiccates and shreds the internal pith tissue in late season under drought stress.
